title: CMS-Senior-SailPoint IIQ-IDN
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The IdentityNow Security Senior Analyst role will be primarily responsible for leading support team that is delivering and supporting software that are critical pieces of the IdentityNow SaaS solution, the daily operations support, enhancements, and review of the Identity Management application and underlying infrastructure, also adhering to stated SLA’s and ensuring high standards for quality in regard to project documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Should have experience on IdentityNow SaaS solution L2/L3 support
* Will be responsible for applications onboarding
* Facilitate project activities by managing risk and issue mitigations, establish project schedule, and manage change controls.
* Partner with Product Management to ensure your team has clear tactical and strategic backlogs
* Balance competing priorities to ensure we effectively ship new features while resolving defects and managing technical debt
* Recruit, coach, develop, and motivate high performing engineers
* Proactively seek to listen and find alignment with other engineering teams and stakeholders by understanding your team's technology, building strong relationships, and insisting on high\-quality solutions
* Deep knowledge of SaaS products, agile processes (Preferably SCRUM) and workflows, and experience implementing them
* Technical experience and fluency at the product/solution/architecture level, enabling easy discussions with engineers
* An exceptional mentor and leader with a passion for continuous improvement
* Experience in implementing /supporting at least two IAM engagements including application support (IdentityNow / other IAM)
* Experience in technologies, such as Java, Ldap, RDBMS and Linux.
* Good knowledge of Web/application servers (IIS, WebSphere WebLogic, JBoss and Apache)
* Experience in development configuration of standard custom IAM integrations using java or other major scripting languages.
* Experience in hands on development, estimations, sizing and custom IAM integrations.
* Advanced documentation and presentation skills and well\-versed with SDLC process.
* Exposure to process frameworks and methodologies.
* Should have experience in interacting with Clients, including working with client teams in an onsite and offshore delivery model.
* Automating of manual tasks performed by administration team.
* Customize, configure, and develop IdentityNow solution integrations using requirements and design and independently manage project deliverables to successful completion.
* Troubleshoot IdentityNow Issues


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor or college degree in related field or equivalent work experience


**Work Experience**
* 5\-10 years’ experience


**Skills Expertise:**
* IdentityNow managed support experience and application onboarding
* Knowledge on Java, Scripting knowledge like PowerShell, Perl etc.
* Good soft skills i.e., verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc.
* Exposure to global security standards e.g., PCI, SOX, HIPAA etc.
* Prior experience working in remote teams on global scale.
* Customer orientation skills.


**Certification:**
* SailPoint Certified IdentityNow Engineer (Good to have)


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support
* Willingness to work in 24\*7 rotational shifts as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vastu Housing Finance Corporation Ltd., based in Mumbai, is a housing finance company focused on delivering responsible and sustainable credit solutions across India. The organization prioritizes financial inclusion by serving underserved and self\-employed communities in peri\-urban and rural areas, enabling homeownership and long\-term financial stability. Using deep local insights and its proprietary technology platform, Pulse, Vastu provides simple, swift, and customized housing finance solutions that bridge the formal credit gap. As of March 2025, Vastu has supported over 100,000 customers, many with modest monthly incomes and limited documentation, who traditionally struggle to access formal credit. With operations across 15 states and union territories and 340\+ districts, the company offers a decade\-long track record of strong governance, consistent profitability, and robust asset quality.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role is based in Tamil Nadu, India. The Relationship Manager will manage and grow a portfolio of housing finance customers, guiding prospective borrowers through the end\-to\-end loan lifecycle from lead generation and initial inquiry to documentation, credit assessment support, disbursement, and post\-disbursement relationship management. Daily responsibilities include sourcing new business in designated markets, conducting customer visits, understanding customer income profiles and housing needs, and explaining loan products, terms, and processes in a clear and ethical manner. The role involves coordinating with credit, operations, and collections teams to ensure timely processing, compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements, and maintaining strong asset quality. The Relationship Manager will also monitor customer accounts, address service issues, encourage timely repayments, and represent Vastu as a trusted partner in local communities.
   

**Qualifications**
* Customer relationship management skills with the ability to build trust, understand needs, and maintain long\-term borrower relationships.
* Business development and sales skills, including lead generation, field sourcing, and closing housing finance opportunities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English and local languages, with the ability to explain financial products clearly and respectfully.
* Basic financial analysis and credit understanding, including assessment of income profiles, documentation, and repayment capacity.
* Familiarity with housing finance, retail lending, or broader financial services, especially in peri\-urban and rural markets.
* Comfort with using digital tools and platforms (mobile apps, CRM systems, and loan management systems) to manage customer data and workflows.
* Ability to work on\-site in the field, travel within assigned territory, and operate independently while adhering to company policies and compliance standards.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; prior experience in housing finance or NBFCs is an advantage.

title: Client & Customer Success Executive - B2B
description:
This is a year\-round role owning the customer experience end to end — day\-to\-day individual customer support for most of the year, with added ownership of corporate/B2B client servicing during high\-volume festive periods like Diwali gifting season.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 Year\-Round Customer Support
 


* Handle day\-to\-day customer queries across calls, email, and WhatsApp — order status, delivery delays, product issues, complaints
* Resolve issues within defined response and resolution SLAs
* Track recurring complaint patterns and flag them upstream to operations/product teams
* Maintain a clean, up\-to\-date log of all customer interactions and resolutions



 Corporate/B2B Client Servicing (Seasonal Peak — Diwali \& similar)
 


* Own corporate client coordination during bulk/festive gifting cycles — order confirmation, customization requirements, delivery timelines
* Act as the single point of contact for corporate clients through the order lifecycle, from confirmation to delivery
* Coordinate closely with operations/logistics to prevent delays on bulk orders
* Handle escalations from corporate clients promptly and professionally



 Customer Experience \& Retention
 


* Track CSAT/NPS across both individual and corporate accounts
* Identify and follow up with corporate clients ahead of recurring occasions to drive repeat business
* Suggest process improvements based on recurring customer/client pain points



  





**Requirements** 




 Must\-have
 


* 1\-3 years of experience in customer support or client success (D2C or B2B)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable managing both routine customer support and corporate client relationships, especially during peak season
* Organized and able to manage multiple queries/accounts with competing deadlines



 Good to have
 


* Prior experience with bulk/corporate order handling or B2B account coordination
* Familiarity with CRM or ticketing tools (Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, or similar)
